description: New high breakout confirmation — distinguishing genuine breakouts from false ones at all-time highs
context: User asking about stocks making new 52-week or all-time highs.
user_input_examples: 茅台创新高了，现在能买吗？
股价创历史新高后回踩，是机会还是陷阱？

structure.current_status: New high type and market context
structure.analysis: Volume confirmation + sector confirmation + fundamental support
structure.risks: False breakout at highs is more damaging than at lows

key_principles: All-time highs have no technical resistance — pure momentum and fundamentals matter
Volume on breakout day should be >1.5x 20-day average for confirmation
New highs with sector peers also at highs = broad-based strength, more reliable
New highs after long consolidation (>3 months) are more reliable than after short rallies
Institutional ownership increase during the consolidation period is a strong bullish signal

decision_tree.if_new_high_with_volume_and_sector_confi: Buy 1/2 position, add on first pullback to breakout level
decision_tree.if_new_high_then_immediate_reversal_belo: Stop out immediately, false breakout confirmed
